{
  "name": "cm-git-branch",
  "displayName": "Git Branch Above Prompt",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Shows the current git branch, how many files changed and ahead/behind counts in a one-line band above the prompt.",
  "author": {
    "name": "ClaudeMods",
    "url": "https://claudemods.app"
  },
  "homepage": "https://claudemods.app/mods/cm-git-branch",
  "repository": "https://github.com/rotbit/claudemods-marketplace",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "git",
    "branch",
    "above prompt",
    "band",
    "status"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "intervalMs": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Refresh interval (ms)",
      "description": "How often to re-read git status between turns, in milliseconds (at least 2000).",
      "min": 2000,
      "max": 3600000,
      "default": 15000
    },
    "showAheadBehind": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show ahead/behind",
      "description": "Show commits ahead of and behind the upstream branch (↑1 ↓0).",
      "default": true
    },
    "hideWhenClean": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Hide when clean",
      "description": "Hide the band while the work tree is clean and in sync with its upstream.",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
